findings.diagnosis: BIG, 'Improve account access', combines a three-day session-token verifier and an independent three-day account-recovery UI into six days of work. Either can ship alone; bundling them delays independent delivery and hides progress beyond the 1-3 day target.
findings.recommended_action: Split BIG into two three-day tickets, one for the session-token verifier and one for the account-recovery UI, so either can ship independently.
